name: Lzhivoye otkroveniye
source: A post-Soviet slice-of-life visual novel. A teenager skips school, eats shawarma at 1 am, and ends up in a world he doesn't recognize. There's a voice in his head that he thinks is his own.
translation: A post-Soviet slice-of-life visual novel. A teenager skips school, eats shawarma at 1 am, and ends up in a world he doesn't recognize. There's a voice in his head that he thinks is his own.
